projects.description:
>Grant & Cross-Border Payment Tracking PortalObjective: Developed a portal for operations teams and corporate customers to trackSWIFT cross-border payments from initiation to settlement, including paymentstatus, exception handling, SWIFT reference search, and reconciliation.>SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 (CBPR+) MigrationObjective: To enable the bank to transition from SWIFT MT messages to ISO 20022(MX) under the CBPR+ program for cross-border payments, ensuring regulatorycompliance, standardized messaging, enhanced data quality, and uninterruptedpayment processing.Roles and Responsibilities:
Acted as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product owners, andtechnical teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functionalrequirements.
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for domestic and cross-borderpayment solutions using Finastra Global PAYplus (GPP) and Temenos PaymentsHub (TPH).
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria forpayment system enhancements.
Defined and validated SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 (MX) message mapping (e.g.,MT103 → pacs.008, MT202 → pacs.009) in accordance with CBPR+ guidelines.
Worked on SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT), SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst),and SEPA Direct Debit (SDD) payment flows.
Gathered and documented business requirements for SEPA payment processing,clearing, settlement, and exception handling..
Worked with payment messaging standards including SWIFTMT1xx/MT2xx/MT9xx, ISO 20022 (pacs, pain), SEPA, and CBPR+.
Coordinated API and integration discussions with Core Banking, Payment Hub,and external banking systems to ensure seamless end-to-end payment .
